prompt: Built-in imagegen: square 3x3 prehistoric artifact swatch centered on useful natural forks, ivory paper and matte gouache. Cells: twice-used natural hollow, resin-sealed bark seam, flexed rib among root prongs, moved pebble line, worn rope bend on branch, grease nutshell in tree fork, draft feather in split branch, water-stained forked branch, charcoal fragment held by raw clay.

entries.review: Top-left: natural rock hollow showing pale seed dust over an older soot-dark residue layer.
Top-middle: ragged bark strips overlapping in a branch fork with raw amber resin on the seam.
Top-right: curved animal rib flexed between rough natural root prongs, no string or weapon.
Middle-left: four unlike natural pebbles by root fingers with one moved onto an upright root.
Middle-middle: rough fiber rope turning around a branch fork, frayed except at the rubbed bend.
Middle-right: small cracked nutshell with pale grease protected inside a tree fork.
Bottom-left: loose feather trapped in a branch split, its soft strands lifted by moving air.
Bottom-middle: forked branch partly submerged, bark visibly darkened to an older waterline.
Bottom-right: lump of raw unfired clay holding a charcoal fragment in a branch crotch.
